WITH scope_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) as avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
),
scope_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as mean_of_averages
  FROM scope_stats
)
SELECT 
  s.acctscope,
  s.avg_net_fee_rate,
  s.count,
  s.avg_net_fee_rate - sm.mean_of_averages as deviation_from_mean
FROM scope_stats s
CROSS JOIN scope_mean sm
ORDER BY s.acctscope
